Title: catatonic fear and blood of acid

Messages.Author: Jan Willem Wijsman
Messages.Body:
What happens if blood of acid was played, and the opposing vampire plays
catatonic fear in superior mode? Does this vampire get 1 aggravated
damage?
Thanks, JW. (The Netherlands)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
jw.wi...@wxs.nl wrote:
> What happens if blood of acid was played, and the opposing vampire plays
> catatonic fear in superior mode? Does this vampire get 1 aggravated
> damage?

No. Card text on Blood of Acid: "during strike resolution...".
That timing is thwarted by any Strike: Cmbat Ends.
